about: The named characters' census for O59: each name number with its NpcParam rows (id, teamType, npcType), each row's placements (map, entityId, talkId, model; _10 map variants kept as read), the talk groups and maps it appears in, and its boss slots from boss-leads.json. From DataPiler's jobs en-0013 and en-0014 on game 2.7.2.0. Numbers only: no names or game text. Every lead is unverified until EldenNet checks it in game (O48); team and type numbers carry no meaning here until then.

patterns.talkSuffix: Every talk id's last four digits are its map's code: the first four digits of a dungeon map's id, 6000 in the open world (m60), 6100 in the expansion's (m61). 341 of 341 placements with a talk id.
patterns.talkGroup: A talk id's first three digits equal the row's name number // 100 - 1000 in 324 of 341 placements; the 17 others are in groupExceptions (one name using another's talk group).
patterns.flagBlocks: No simple numeric rule links the 55 flag blocks of npc-flags.json to talk groups (at most 16 of 55 under the rules tried: base // 10, (base - 3000) // 20 + 300, (base - 3000) // 10 + 300). The link waits for EldenNet's in-game check.
patterns.minusOne: Three placements carry -1 as talk id and model; kept as read.
